0.long_answer: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is an ANCA-associated vasculitis that primarily affects small- to medium-sized vessels and is known to cause saddle nose deformity due to the damage and perforation of the nasal septum. This condition, formerly known as Wegener's granulomatosis, frequently involves the upper respiratory tract, including the nose and sinuses, leading to chronic inflammation, tissue destruction, and ultimately the characteristic saddle nose deformity.
